title: Herbert Larry's big band and the trio
summary: Larry's band reached 14 men with two basses; they sort out which photo shows the trio.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Turn around. Is there anything about the... Larry's band you can tell us anything that you'd like to say about... that group? Did it change very often? Was that a pretty big band?
No, that was a big band. They had... At one time, he had... Where is that? Well, this picture here, I'll show you. Where at this time, he had 14 men. He had two basses.
How did that work out? Let's see.
That's it. No, no, that's not our trio. No, that's no... That's the trio.
Because the Clarence and the Manuel... Wait, was Manuel in the other one? Yes. Manuel, Clarence, and you.
